text.en: Believing the neutrino is essentially undetectable and therefore not really a physical particle, just a bookkeeping device to make the energy balance work out -- the neutrino was originally proposed as exactly that kind of bookkeeping fix by Pauli, but it was later directly detected experimentally (Cowan-Reines experiment, 1956) via its weak interactions with matter, confirming it as a genuine, if extremely weakly interacting, physical particle rather than merely a mathematical convenience.
text.et: Arvamus, et neutriino on sisuliselt tuvastamatu ja seetõttu mitte tegelikult füüsikaline osake, vaid ainult raamatupidamislik abivahend energiabilansi klappimiseks -- neutriino pandi algselt ette täpselt sellise raamatupidamisliku parandusena Pauli poolt, kuid see tuvastati hiljem otse eksperimentaalselt (Cowani-Reinesi katse, 1956) selle nõrkade vastastikmõjude kaudu ainega, kinnitades seda tõelise, kuigi äärmiselt nõrgalt interakteeruva füüsikalise osakesena, mitte ainult matemaatilise mugavusena.
